tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "FF7C1087487AED090967BCB1E24106AA", "The Mayor has proposed an expansion of a service building. Expansions grant boons like bonuses or new crafting options.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "A2EC5D9E4DC88DED83CEA582FF7D1B35", "Citizens can show their support or disagreement with an expansion by voting in the Citizenship window. Votes in favor shorten construction time, votes against increase it.")
